name: @w6w-apps/jotform
description: Read Jotform forms and questions, and read, create, edit and delete form submissions via the Jotform API.

w6w.longDescription:
Jotform builds and hosts online forms, and this app reads what's been built and manages what comes in. List a user's forms and their questions, then read, create, edit and delete individual submissions — the day-to-day work of running a form once it's published, rather than designing one.

Submissions can be pulled per form or across every form on the account, and created or edited using the same field-keyed structure Jotform's own API expects, including multi-part answers like a full name or address. Reports and folders round out the picture for organizing and summarizing what a form collects.

A fit for routing new form submissions into another system, updating a submission's status as a workflow processes it, or pulling usage and submission data into a report — without needing form-building or account-administration capabilities, which stay in Jotform's own designer.
